config.notes: Royal Roads (Canada). Page kinds: royalroads.ca/programs/<slug> program pages (Drupal, no page data) and commons.royalroads.ca/mais/program-source/ pages (MA Interdisciplinary Studies stream pages, no program-details panel). Program pages have a program-details panel per upcoming start: the start date is printed as a heading just before "Application deadline", then the deadline date, "Program length" (some), "Delivery model", "Domestic tuition" and "International tuition". Tuition is labelled "Tuition estimates shown are for the entire program", so it is a whole-program total and is NOT read as fee. The page also lists scholarships ("Up to $25,000") that the general reader wrongly took as fee. IELTS is not on the page: it links to the central page https://www.royalroads.ca/admission/english-language-requirements (blocked to automated reads, 403). No terms are printed, so no term_months.
